name: Pitty Pat
description: Pitty Pat is a rummy-like game from Belize. Object: make three pairs. No melding to table; players collect pairs in hand. Draw one, discard one. First to show three pairs wins. Simple, fast.

overview.description: Pitty Pat is a rummy-like game from Belize. Object: make three pairs. No melding to table; players collect pairs in hand. Draw one, discard one. First to show three pairs wins. Simple, fast.

history.origins: Pitty Pat is the national card game of Belize. It is essentially a rummy game with a similar mechanism to Conquian: the objective is to make three pairs from a five-card hand. Full rules are documented on the Belizeans.com web site; a computer program for the game is available from Unique Games.
timeline: National card game of Belize; full rules at Belizeans.com; software from Unique Games.

setup.players: Two to four players use a standard 52-card pack. Each player receives five cards; deal and play proceed clockwise as described in the primary sources.

rules.objective: Make three pairs from your hand. Each turn draw one card from the stock or the discard pile, then discard one. Pairs stay in hand; no melding to the table. First player to hold and show three pairs wins.
rules.gameplay: 1. Draw one from stock or discard. 2. Discard one. 3. Pairs stay in hand. 4. When you have three pairs, show them to win.
keyRules: No melding to table until winning.
First to show three pairs wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Belize. Draw, discard. Three pairs to win.
